events.text: A missile attack by the Houthis kills 53 soldiers and injure over 200 at a training center in Shabwah Governorate, Yemen.
Three children are killed in an alleged Rapid Support Forces drone strike in Khartoum, Sudan.
Twelve migrants, including an infant, are killed when two separate speedboats capsize off the coast of the Lesbos and Samos islands in Greece.
Six miners are killed and at least 12 others are missing when an open pit gold mine collapses in Nariño Department, Colombia.

events.topic: Andorra–European Union relations, San Marino–European Union relations, Potential enlargement of the European Union
events.text: Andorra and San Marino each sign an association agreement with the European Union.

events.topic: Gaza Strip famine, Palestine and the United Nations
events.text: The World Food Programme cuts monthly food aid for about 500,000 people in the Gaza Strip because of funding shortages, reducing the number of recipients from 1.6 million to 1.1 million.

A Kenyan court convicts Good News International Ministries leader Paul Nthenge Mackenzie of murdering 190 children and an adult whose deaths were linked to starvation in Shakahola Forest.

A car deliberately strikes independent Australian MP Helen Haines outside her office in Wangaratta, Victoria, leaving her in critical condition and without a leg. Police arrest the driver, while Haines is airlifted to a hospital.
Albertans vote on ten referendums, including one to decide if Alberta should seek separation from Canada.
